name: Refrigerator Chess
author: alexh@isyourrefrigerator.online
description: Full-stack real-time chess platform with Stockfish 16.1 AVX2 engine, PvP invite match system, PvE boss bot progression, and tactical puzzles.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Refrigerator Chess Pelican Egg Installation Script
# Target Container: debian:bookworm-slim
set -e

echo "=== [1/5] Installing system packages ==="
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl \
    tar \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    sqlite3 \
    xz-utils \
    nodejs \
    npm

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "=== [2/5] Fetching application repository ==="
if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "Repository already exists, pulling updates..."
    git pull || true
elif [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning from ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
    git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
elif [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "Application files already present in /mnt/server."
else
    echo "Cloning repository..."
    git clone https://github.com/Trollmeneerr/Chess.git . || true
fi

echo "=== [3/5] Setting up Stockfish 16.1 AVX2 Engine ==="
mkdir -p /mnt/server/engine
SF_URL="https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/download/sf_16.1/stockfish-ubuntu-x86-64-avx2.tar"
if curl -sL --fail "$SF_URL" -o /tmp/stockfish.tar; then
    tar -xf /tmp/stockfish.tar -C /tmp
    SF_BIN=$(find /tmp -type f -name "*stockfish*" | head -n 1)
    if [ -n "$SF_BIN" ]; then
        mv "$SF_BIN" /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
        chmod +x /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
        echo "✓ Stockfish 16.1 AVX2 binary installed at /mnt/server/engine/stockfish"
    fi
    rm -rf /tmp/stockfish*
else
    echo "Warning: Could not fetch Stockfish release tarball. Falling back to apt-get stockfish package..."
    apt-get install -y stockfish || true
    if which stockfish; then
        cp $(which stockfish) /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
        chmod +x /mnt/server/engine/stockfish
    fi
fi

echo "=== [4/5] Installing Node.js dependencies ==="
if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    npm ci || npm install --production
fi

echo "=== [5/5] Initializing Database & Puzzles ==="
if [ -f "src/cli/seed-puzzles.js" ]; then
    node src/cli/seed-puzzles.js || echo "Puzzles will auto-seed upon first server startup."
fi

echo "=== Refrigerator Chess installation finished successfully ==="

variables.name: Custom Subdomain
variables.description: The subdomain domain name used for generating invite links, CORS origin validation, and WebSocket origin headers.

variables.name: Stockfish Max Depth
variables.description: Hard search cap for Stockfish engine evaluations (Strictly enforced at 8 as per specification to prevent CPU bottlenecking).

variables.name: Stockfish Hash Memory (MB)
variables.description: Memory allocation in megabytes for the Stockfish transposition hash table.

variables.name: Stockfish CPU Threads
variables.description: Number of CPU threads allocated to the Stockfish engine process.

variables.name: Database Host
variables.description: Pelican Panel Database Host IP or hostname (e.g. 172.18.0.1). Leave empty to use local SQLite fallback.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB database name provisioned from Pelican Panel's Database tab.

variables.name: Database Username
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB username provisioned from Pelican Panel.

variables.name: Database Password
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB password provisioned from Pelican Panel.

variables.name: Puzzle ELO Reward
variables.description: Rating points awarded to user upon solving a tactical puzzle without using the solution hint.

variables.name: Bot Low ELO Reward
variables.description: Base rating points awarded for defeating a bot lower than or equal to player rating.

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone during egg installation.
